statement: For every complex s, if the meromorphic continuation of the Riemann zeta function is zero at s and s is not a negative even integer, then Re(s)=1/2.
initial_definition: The Dirichlet series defines zeta only for Re(s)>1; use its unique meromorphic continuation elsewhere.
